item.description: Here's your Woodchuck Weather. Tonight, expect mostly cloudy to partly cloudy skies with a chance of rain showers and low temperatures ranging from the low thirties to the upper thirties across the region. Tomorrow brings mostly cloudy to partly sunny conditions with high temperatures from the low forties to the upper forties and only a slight chance of precipitation. Showers return tomorrow night, with rain likely and some areas seeing a mix with snow, as lows drop into the low thirties.
